_comment: No datasets are pre-registered: the app opens with an empty 'Your datasets' list so people only ever see what they upload themselves. The former SIMULATED demo entry is preserved below under `_examples` (which the app does NOT load) — move it back into `datasets` to re-enable a bundled demo.

_examples.name: Indian coastal survey (SIMULATED demonstration data)
_examples.note: SIMULATED. Reads are generated from real COI reference sequences in data/reference_coi_india/, so classifications are genuine; which species occur where is invented. Ground truth in data/demo_survey/truth.json. Do not present as field data.
_examples.expect: 12 samples, 6 sites x 2 rounds. Invasive species increasing 1.9x between rounds; olive ridley and green turtle at protected sites. ~3 min.
